## Books

[*Immigration and Canada: Sixteen Questions*](https://www.mqup.ca/Books/I/Immigration-and-Canada). 2026. Montréal: McGill-Queen's University Press. With Jennifer Elrick.

[*Province Building and the Federalization of Immigration in Canada*](https://utppublishing.com/doi/book/10.3138/9781487501402). 2019. Toronto: University of Toronto Press.

[*La fédéralisation de l'immigration au Canada*](https://pum.umontreal.ca/catalogue/la-federalisation-de-limmigration-au-canada). 2016. Montréal: Presses de l'Université de Montréal. Winner of the 2016–2018 Best French-Language Book Prize, Canadian Political Science Association.

## Edited volumes

[*Crossing Lines: Comics about Human Migration*](https://utppublishing.com/doi/10.3138/9781049801223). 2025. Toronto: University of Toronto Press. Edited with Antje Ellermann, Frederik Byrn Køhlert and Sarah Leavitt. Listed in the Hill Times' Top 100 Best Books of 2025. [Project page](https://migration.ubc.ca/graphic-narratives-of-migration-workshop)

[*Knowledge, Power, and Migration: Contesting the North/South Divide*](https://mqup.ca/knowledge--power--and-migration-products-9780228024651.php). 2025. Montréal: McGill-Queen's University Press. Edited with Yasmeen Abu-Laban and Ethel Tungohan. Listed in the Hill Times' Top 100 Best Books of 2025.

[*Nouvelles dynamiques de l'immigration au Québec*](https://pum.umontreal.ca/catalogue/nouvelles_dynamiques_de_limmigration_au_quebec). 2022. Montréal: Presses de l'Université de Montréal.

[*Citizenship as a Regime: Canadian and International Perspectives*](https://www.mqup.ca/Books/C/Citizenship-as-a-Regime2). 2018. Montréal: McGill-Queen's University Press. Edited with Nora Nagels and Aude-Claire Fourot.
